description: This file contains driver-related functions for Realtek Ethernet PHY devices, including delay functions, register access APIs, and power and loopback configurations.

methods.name: void rtk_phylib_mdelay(uint32 msec)
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds, using either Linux-specific delay or OS abstraction layer.

methods.name: void rtk_phylib_udelay(uint32 usec)
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of microseconds, using either Linux-specific delay or OS abstraction layer.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_mmd_write(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 mmd,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 data)
methods.description: Writes data to a specific register in the PHY device via MMD, with Linux and non-Linux implementations.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_mmd_read(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 mmd,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 * pData)
methods.description: Reads data from a specific register in the PHY device via MMD, with Linux and non-Linux implementations.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_power_normal(rtk_phydev * phydev)
methods.description: Sets the PHY device to normal power mode.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_power_low(rtk_phydev * phydev)
methods.description: Sets the PHY device to low power mode.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_pcs_loopback(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 enable)
methods.description: Enables or disables PCS loopback mode on the PHY device.
